name: Kambal
description: The Consul of Allocation who pressures Sram to obey Tezzeret's order and then flees the Hub.

authors: Nik Davidson, Kelly Digges, and Kimberly J. Kreines
description_citations.text: "Revolution Begins" by Nik Davidson, Kelly Digges, and Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: Ghirapur hosts the Inventors' Fair and the Aether Revolt in 4560 AR, changing the city's leadership.
timeline.quote: causing a change in leadership for the city, with Pia Nalaar becoming part of the Consulate, while Kambal and Dovin Baan both lost their respective positions

citation.text: "Ghirapur", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A thopter photographs the group and delivers the images to Consul Kambal aboard the Skysovereign.
timeline.quote: one that showed the target, Nalaar, daughter of Renegade Prime

citation.text: "In This Very Arena" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Kambal tells the courier to inform Inspector Baan that the bait is set and the confiscation can be prepared.
timeline.quote: Alert Inspector Baan. The bait is set. Prepare the confiscation.

citation.text: "In This Very Arena" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Consul Kambal demands Sram carry out Tezzeret's order to divert the city's aether to the Spire; Sram demands it in writing.
timeline.quote: "You have your orders, Senior Edificer," said Kambal.

authors: Nik Davidson, Kelly Digges, and Kimberly J. Kreines
citation.text: "Revolution Begins" by Nik Davidson, Kelly Digges, and Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: Explosions at the Hub interrupt the dispute and Kambal flees by airship.
timeline.quote: "Explosion at junction nine!" said an edificer.

authors: Nik Davidson, Kelly Digges, and Kimberly J. Kreines
citation.text: "Revolution Begins" by Nik Davidson, Kelly Digges, and Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: Lord Gonti met with Consul Kambal on the day the Prakhata Club closed.
timeline.quote: It's also rare that Lord Gonti meets with Consul Kambal.

citation.text: Prakhata Club Security (Battlebond, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

relations.quote: Kambal, the Consul of Allocation, was the only one of those superiors who still gave Sram orders.

authors: Nik Davidson, Kelly Digges, and Kimberly J. Kreines
citation.text: "Revolution Begins" by Nik Davidson, Kelly Digges, and Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jan 2017.

citation.text: "In This Very Arena" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Oct 2016.
